## Profile Summary

Research Scientist at the HTA Resource Hub, IIPHG, with prior experience as Senior Research Fellow (Health Economics) at PGIMER, Chandigarh. My research focuses on Health Economics, HTA, and Mental Health Economics, combining positive health economics (trend analysis, hypothesis generation, prediction) with normative approaches, including economic evaluation and decision-analytic modelling. I have strong expertise in quantitative research methods, systematic reviews and meta-analysis, econometric and structural equation modelling, spatial analysis, and machine-learning-based prediction, with advanced proficiency in R, Stata, Python, SPSS, and GIS tools. I have published in indexed journals, contributed to funded grants (DHR, SERB, SERB-MATRICS), and delivered teaching and workshops in health economics and research methods.

## Work Experience

**Indian Institute of Public Health Gandhinagar (IIPHG), *Gujarat, India \| October 2025 - Present***

- Preparing HTA protocols and presenting to the HTAIn Technical Advisory Committee (DHR), incorporating expert recommendations.

- Contributing to institutional capacity-building in health economics research.

- Coordinating with HTAIn, Department of Health Research (MoHFW), Government of India.

- Developing and applying advanced econometric and decision-analytic models, including Decision Tree and Markov models.

- Conducting systematic reviews and meta-analyses, including critical appraisal and evidence synthesis for HTA.

- Reviewing the HTA outcome reports of resource centres under the IIPHG HTA resource hub and do the Quality Appraisal.

- Delivering HTA sensitization workshops for central and state government stakeholders.

- Coordinating and facilitating national and international HTA training programs.

- Teaching health economics and related subjects to Master’s-level students.
